properties.name: reflow2 stamps each node write with its own sealed time, and a prediction reads whether it came before its result
properties.rationale: Accepted 2026-10-28: req:reflow2-stamps-the-server-time-on-each-node-creation-and-content-change and req:a-prediction-reads-whether-it-was-stated-before-the-result-it-is-tested-by, under dec:prediction-order-is-read-from-server-recorded-times-and-said-not-enforced-2026-10-28 (accepted) and dec:write-stamps-stay-in-the-store-and-travel-in-an-export-only-when-asked-2026-10-28 (option C, proposed: the owner may veto before merge). Measured first on main 73b29e4: reflow2 recorded no server-side time for a node's creation or content change; every dated property was caller-typed; snapshots kept wording without time; an export's content_hash is an unkeyed SHA-256 any writer can recompute, so a chain cannot vouch for a time, which is why the seal is keyed and the key never leaves the store. Stamps sit in the stored map and are stripped at the engine's reads so the format is unchanged and an older reflow2 still opens the store. With stamps in every export (option A) four existing tests failed, the worst being two branches accepting one checksum conflicting on the Artifact item the per-item layout exists to keep mergeable; option C keeps all four unchanged. flo2's backup tars store directories and its move moves them, so stamps and key travel there with no flo2 change. Golden moves: readings_before_the_shared_evaluation.json, four-colour and riemann only, gaining order_not_recorded lines. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Gap 3 of the design-a-phenomenon skill. (1) crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/store/engine/stamps.rs: every node write stores server_created_at, server_changed_at and server_seal (HMAC-SHA256 under a key kept inside the store, over design, node, both times and the content hash), from the server's clock; a write naming a stamp is refused on every path; every engine read strips them, so no reply, receipt, comparison or content hash changes; DesignGraph::node_stamp reads them, recorded here only when the seal verifies against the content as it stands; an imported creation is never re-sealed. No store format change. export_graph carries them only with stamps: true (in node properties on disk; ExportedNode.stamps in memory); an item-layout path refuses them and the layout writer clears them, so the design copy never holds them. (2) crates/reflow2-core/src/prediction_order.rs and reasoning_report.prediction_order: each result (statement_kind evidence) that is a premise of a walked step beside Requirement premises (supports), or CONTRADICTS a walked node (contests), read against the prediction's stamps: stated_before_the_result, stated_after_the_result (post hoc), revised_after_the_result (earlier_wording_in names the snapshot), changed_after_the_result, order_not_recorded, imported_not_recorded_here. Said, never enforced; absent when no result tests anything. The phenomenon skill (and mirrors) teaches it and narrows the honest limit; skill_lint allows the two field terms; edge_readers.yaml lists prediction_order_over; export_graph's toolsnap gains `stamps`. Tests: the_server_stamps_each_node_creation_and_content_change.rs (core, 10) and a_prediction_reads_whether_it_was_stated_before_its_result.rs (MCP, 7).
